hypothesis: Narrative compression — summarize old steps to keep prompts bounded
ceo_rationale: Narrative compression implementation is correct, fully tested (103 tests, 11 new), and addresses a critical blocker for long-running simulations. Clean lint, backward compatible (optional narrative_budget parameter). Token savings of 40-60% for 50+ step runs enable multi-agent interaction at scale.
learned: Narrative compression via summarization (not truncation) preserves causal context while enabling bounded prompts, critical for long simulations with many decision points.
anti_patterns: Do not discard old steps outright (loses state consistency);
Do not re-summarize every compression event (memoize summaries)

playbook_proposals.content: For long-running multi-step workflows, implement narrative compression early (budget tokens before prompt grows too large)
Simulations over 50+ steps require bounded-prompt mechanisms. Narrative compression or sliding-context windows are non-negotiable for production runs.
